node.title: L1 marked constant-shift Forney-window normal form
node.statement: Every marked common constant-shift survivor with t<=2m in strip m has a reduced rank-two interpolation-module basis of Forney degrees mu<=nu<=m, mu+nu=t, and determinant kappa product_i(Z-a_i). Its degree-at-most-m coefficient kernel has exact dimension 2m-t+2 and full row rank t. The enlarged numerator/denominator have a unique reconstruction from those generators, with evaluated multiplier gcd dividing the mark locator J. Every admissible Forney pair is populated by an explicit saturated family F=1+lambda X^cR(P)V(P), W=U(P), so the finite strata must be priced or profile-owned rather than excluded.
